> Player-facing bosses, side quests, rhythm skills, outfits, biomes, procedural setpieces, UI polish, materials and VFX should normally use the **Content Request** template instead. Melodia's default is to compose with the proven stack, not add architecture.

## What experience is blocked?

Describe the player/artist outcome you cannot currently author.

## Existing capability check

Which existing production surfaces did you inspect first?

- [ ] QuillScript / chapter scaffold / stable IDs
- [ ] Phoenix / TurnBased JRPG + existing rhythm seam
- [ ] Wardrobe / traversal / Convergence
- [ ] UE PCG / Python / Resonance Ecology
- [ ] Houdini Engine / Hython / Copernicus
- [ ] Cymatics / Chladni / material + MPC stack
- [ ] Niagara / audio-reactive presentation
- [ ] `melodia-ui-artist` / current UI ownership
- [ ] Other current capability documented in `CURRENT_STATE.md`

## Why can't this be authored as content?

Name the concrete missing seam, invariant, or tool capability. Do not propose a parallel authority when an existing owner can be extended.

## Smallest extension

What is the narrowest change that unblocks content authoring while preserving existing ownership?

## Proof required

What SOURCE/LIVE/RESTART/PACKAGED evidence would demonstrate that the blocker is actually removed?
